answer: Sponsorship-chain liability: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it, and a slash climbs the chain up to 5 levels, so the voucher and the voucher above it both lose their bonds. The copper register exposes who carries the risk at each level, the yarrow replay walks every level, and the atlas audit publishes the total; building a farm of fakes exposes the whole ladder of sponsors at once.
